name: rcl
description: Revised Common Lectionary (Episcopal) data and a single-file web app for reading the appointed lessons

scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:js
scripts.test:py: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s src -t src
scripts.check: python3 src/rcl/datafile.py data/rcl_readings.txt && python3 src/rcl/books.py data/book_urns.txt data/rcl_readings.txt
